question: Which of the following is smaller than 17/24 ?
solution:
[IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/ca81259519cadfb2d5350673c220e419e60378e9770ad26512fc8e826a8d93f1.png] __Shortcut Trick__

Convert the fractions into decimal values for quick comparison:

17 ÷ 24 ≈ 0.708

(1) 13 ÷ 18 ≈ 0.722

(2) 5 ÷ 7 ≈ 0.714

(3) 7 ÷ 11 ≈ 0.636

(4) 11 ÷ 15 ≈ 0.733

**∴ The correct answer is 7/11.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/c76c13ba2d2ab46b47f8a931ae621dac081a0cb266b142dc23f58659fac4a466.png] **__Alternate Method__**

**Given:** Reference fraction = 17/24

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/5b8bdde3489500a5a8ec5ca1f5cd57ef09c4bd3c0ac39beeed43b91fd069758e.png] 

Compare using Cross-Multiplication Method (a/b 168, 17/24 > 7/11.

⇒ Compare 17/24 and 11/15: 17 × 15 = 255 and 24 × 11 = 264. Since 255 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **__Additional Information__**

Cross Multiplication Rule

For two fractions a/b and c/d, if (a × d) (b × c), then a/b > c/d.

Decimal Method

Convert fractions to decimals by dividing the numerator by the denominator to compare their values directly.

Common Denominator Method

Find the LCM of denominators and convert all fractions to have this common denominator; the fraction with the smaller numerator is smaller.
